message.content: MalfurionStormrage suggests focusing on covering basic first aid, emergency response protocols, and communication strategies in training sessions. He also recommends establishing roles for members of the community emergency response team, including team leaders, medics, communication officers, and someone responsible for managing logistics. These roles aim to ensure that everyone understands their responsibilities and can respond effectively during emergencies. Additionally, he advocates for regular training sessions to help team members feel more confident and prepared.
